sources.researchNote: The displayed label is Odeon A 169240 a, with matrix Bi 1641, Bernhard Etté’s dance orchestra and Wolfgang Schmidt. The upload describes a 1933 Lindström recording issued on Gloria in Germany and Odeon abroad; the displayed copy itself bears an Odeon label. The year remains the uploader-reported recording year, not an independently established issue date. The label does not establish a take or the relationship between particular Gloria and Odeon pressings.
